title: Best FP&A Software for CFOs: 8 Cash Flow, Balance Sheet and Three-Statement Planning Providers Compared (2026)
summary: Compare eight FP&A platforms for cash flow, balance sheet and three-statement planning: Abacum, Anaplan, Cube, Datarails, Pigment, Planful, Vena and Workday.
body_markdown:
**Updated November 2026**


The best provider of cash flow, balance sheet and three-statement planning for a CFO is the one that lets you answer your hardest questions from one connected model: can we fund the plan, are we inside our covenants, and what do we tell the board? Eight platforms stand out: Abacum, Anaplan, Cube, Datarails, Pigment, Planful, Vena and Workday Adaptive Planning. They differ on how cash is modeled, whether the work stays in Excel, and how far planning reaches beyond finance.


Abacum is the AI-native FP&A platform finance trusts, and the business planning platform the whole company runs on. It runs on one governed layer of data, logic and context: data is the what, logic is the how, context is the why.


## Key takeaways


-


Choose by decision, not by feature count. Name the five or six decisions your team makes every quarter, then test each platform against them.


-


A cash forecast that sits apart from the P&L and balance sheet goes stale the moment an assumption changes. Three-statement planning keeps all three in step.


-


Run two horizons from one model: a 13-week view for liquidity and a longer view for the plan, both fed by the same actuals.


-


Interest, revolver draws and covenant ratios create circular logic. Check how each engine handles it.


-


Ask who runs the rollout, how long the first plan takes to go live, and which security certifications are current.

## How do the three statements connect?


The three statements link through a few entries. Net income from the income statement flows into retained earnings on the balance sheet. Depreciation is added back in the operating section of the cash flow statement because it is a non-cash expense. Changes in working capital accounts on the balance sheet move operating cash flow. Capital expenditure increases fixed assets and appears in investing cash flow, and debt draws and repayments appear in financing cash flow. The ending cash balance on the cash flow statement becomes the cash line on the balance sheet. Three-statement planning software keeps these links live, so a changed driver moves all three statements together and the balance sheet still balances.


## What to look for in FP&A software for CFOs


1.


**Statement integration.** The P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement are built from live ERP actuals, update together and trace back to the transaction.


2.


**Horizon coverage.** One model supports a 13-week liquidity view and the annual plan on the same actuals and drivers.


3.


**Multi-entity roll-ups.** Look at roll-ups with FX translation, entity structure, and whether more than one ERP can feed the same model.


4.


**Calculation engine.** Test whether interest and revolver draws calculate natively or need an iterative-calculation workaround.


5.


**Scenario reach.** A scenario flows through all three statements without manual links.


6.


**Spreadsheet fit.** Decide whether you want to keep working in Excel or move to a dedicated modeling layer.


7.


**Time to value and security.** Ask who runs the rollout and which certifications are current.

## The eight platforms


### Abacum: three statements, cash and scenarios in one connected model


Abacum builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement from live ERP actuals and keeps revenue, hiring and cash scenarios in the same connected model. Its calculation engine natively supports circular references, so interest, debt balances and revolver draws run without iterative-calculation workarounds. Multi-entity roll-ups use a dimension-based model, with currency translated at the FX rates you set. Implementation is finance-owned and runs six to nine weeks, depending on data complexity, entity count and workflows, guided by in-house FP&A experts. Abacum connects to 700+ integrations, including NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business ByDesign, Sage Intacct, Xero and QuickBooks, through native, automated connections. Abacum is rated 4.7 out of 5 on G2 (October 2026), and is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant.


**Best for:** finance teams running multi-entity, multi-location planning that want statements, cash and scenarios in one connected model.


### Anaplan


Anaplan is a connected-planning platform for teams that plan across finance, sales, supply chain and HR. Its integrated financial statements link the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and it adds AI-assisted scenario modeling ([anaplan.com](https://www.anaplan.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams connecting planning across finance, sales, supply chain and HR.


### Cube


Cube keeps live actuals, assumptions and scenarios maintained together, and supports direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling. It works with Excel and Google Sheets ([cubesoftware.com](https://www.cubesoftware.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling.


### Datarails


Datarails is an Excel-native financial operating system that keeps full Excel functionality. It describes real-time bank connections that give live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility, and 600+ integrations ([datarails.com](https://www.datarails.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility alongside Excel.


### Pigment


Pigment is a flexible modeling platform for teams willing to build and maintain their own planning models. Your team or an implementation partner designs it and keeps it running, so confirm who will own the model after go-live.


**Best for:** teams that want to design and own their own planning models.


### Planful


Planful unifies close, planning and reporting, and includes a 13-week cash flow module with AP, AR and payroll inputs ([planful.com](https://www.planful.com/) ). Comparing Abacum and Planful? See[Abacum vs Planful](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-planful) .


**Best for:** finance teams that need a structured 13-week treasury forecast.


### Vena


Vena delivers Excel-native, Microsoft-native planning with workflow that runs through Microsoft 365, Teams and Power BI. It supports direct and indirect cash flow methods, with weekly, monthly or daily planning intervals.


**Best for:** teams that want driver-based cash modeling inside an Excel-based process.


### Workday Adaptive Planning


Workday Adaptive Planning delivers finance-led planning tied into the Workday HR and finance ecosystem. Its in-memory calculation refreshes plans quickly, and it works with any ERP or GL data source ([workday.com](https://www.workday.com/en-us/products/adaptive-planning/overview.html) ). Comparing Abacum and Adaptive? See[Abacum vs Adaptive](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-adaptive) .


**Best for:** organizations already invested in the Workday ecosystem.
